Name: Claire's Makeover - Seasonal
Author: SingleMaltWhisky
Description:
[size=3]Claire deserves more love so I gave her a makeover.[/size]

[size=5][b]Install instructions:[/b][/size]
[size=2]Just copy the folder from the .zip file into your mods folder. Just make sure you also
have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] installed.
This mod basically overwrites Claire's sprites and portraits of that mod.[/size]

[size=5][b]Credits:[/b][/size]
-[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AgentLyoko/about-me?gameId=1303]AgentLyoko[/url] for the various assets that I used as a base for my modifications.
